_comment: Production build config - api.docwellness.fit (real prod, Oracle VPS) + prod-environment SDK keys. This is the config CI uses for the Play Store release (.github/workflows/build-release-aab.yml). Running the app with this locally talks to the REAL production backend and its patients' data - use config/dev.json for everyday work. Same 'safe to commit' rationale as config/dev.json.
